references.text: This reference confirms that Joseph is still in the same prison where he was placed in 39:20, and shows how God keeps him close to power even while imprisoned.
This verse expands on the consequence of 39:20 by showing how Joseph gained a leading role among the prisoners shortly after his arrival.
A theological contrast that shows how a righteous prisoner (Joseph) bears witness to God's presence, while an unjust imprisonment (Asa) reveals the king's rejection of prophecy.
